summaryParagraphs: I'm a Data Engineer with 4+ years of experience working on core banking systems, legacy reporting modernization, and data engineering in a regulated BFSI environment.

At Tata Consultancy Services, I work on the Reports module of a TCS BaNCS core banking platform, supporting 27 cooperative banks across Tamil Nadu and Puducherry. My production work spans Micro Focus COBOL, Oracle/PLSQL, complex SQL, batch automation, ETL/ELT, OLTP→OLAP data extraction, SFTP-based data delivery, reconciliation, and regulatory reporting.

One of my key contributions was reducing year-end EOD report processing from ~15 hours to 3.5 hours by automating manual report execution and tuning Oracle queries based on execution plans. I have also developed 15+ Oracle SQL extract reports and automated their generation as part of the EOD reporting workflow.

I'm particularly interested in the intersection of legacy systems and modern data engineering — taking reliable, business-critical systems and progressively enabling modern analytics and data platforms. I have collaborated with a client-side data engineer on Databricks KPI models and hold the Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate certification.

Beyond my production work, I build hands-on projects using Python, PySpark, pandas, data modelling, SCD logic, FastAPI, Docker, and AI-assisted development. I also built an AI-assisted Mainframe Modernizer focused on analyzing and transforming legacy COBOL code.

I'm currently looking to move into a Data Engineer / Big Data Engineer / Cloud Data Engineer role where I can combine my production experience in data-intensive banking systems with modern distributed data engineering.

Conducted safety and pre-commissioning audits at operational and new retail outlet sites across the Nellore region, both independently and alongside the regional manager.

projects.name: NYC Taxi Data Engineering & Analytics Platform
projects.summary: A medallion lakehouse on Databricks that turns 1,458,644 raw NYC taxi trips into 20 governed business KPIs — where "trusted" is enforced by code rather than asserted.
detail: Three rules, enforced by scripts and CI rather than convention: no invented thresholds (six cutoffs shipped unset; a build needing one fails rather than defaulting), no silent data loss (outliers are flagged and quarantined with a rule ID, never dropped, with total = valid + quarantined as a dbt test), and no drifting definitions (a KPI formula change requires a contract version bump and a 7-field changelog entry, blocked at pre-commit).

Verified on the real dataset, not a fixture: full 4-task serverless job green, dbt PASS=28 / ERROR=0, reconciliation exact at 1,457,659 + 985 = 1,458,644, Bronze idempotent across repeated ingests, Gold KPI-001 summing to exactly the valid population.

projects.name: Mainframe Modernizer — Multiagent COBOL Modernization Platform
projects.summary: A browser-based platform that converts legacy COBOL programs into modern languages using a multi-agent AI pipeline powered by Google Gemini.
detail: Unlike simple LLM wrappers, it orchestrates 8 specialized agents across 4 pipeline stages — Developer Agent (conversion) → 4 Analysis Agents (DSA, System Design, Performance, Business Logic) → Bug Report Agent (aggregation & prioritization) → Fix Agent (iterative auto-correction). The loop runs up to 3 times before escalating unresolved issues to human review.
All analysis agents call Gemini with an enforced response schema, guaranteeing type-safe, parseable output every time — no regex hacks, no parsing fragility.
